/** pcgSql - checkProject - 차수과제코드 체크 */ SELECT B.VPROJECTCODE as "vProjectCode" , A.VKEYPROJECTNAME as "vKeyProjectName" , A.VKEYPROJECTCODE as "vKeyProjectCode" , C.VTEAMNAME as "vDeptName" , A.VPROORGNAME as "vGovName" , A.VPROJECTDIVISION as "vProjectDivision" , A.VSTARTDATE as "vTotStartDate" , A.VENDDATE as "vTotEndDate" , B.VSTARTDATE as "vStartDate" , B.VENDDATE as "vEndDate" , A.VMANAGER as "vProjectPm" , D.VNAME as "vProjectPmName" , A.VGOAL as "vProjectGoal" FROM TCZ2003 A, TCZ2006 B, (SELECT VTEAMCODE, VTEAMNAME FROM TAZ2001 WHERE VUSEYN = 'Y' AND VTEAMFLAG IN ('1', '2')) C, TAA2101 D
AND A.VKEYPROJECTCODE = B.VKEYPROJECTCODE AND B.VPROJECTSTEP = '3' AND B.VPROJECTCODE = #{vProjectCode} AND A.VDEPTCODE = C.VTEAMCODE(+) AND A.VMANAGER = D.VEMPLNO

/** pcgSql - copyPgc - 인원관리 복사 */ INSERT INTO TCA4002 ( VESTICODE , VEMPLNO , VNAME , VDEPTNAME , VTEAMNAME , VPOSNAME , VPASSWORD , VGRADE , VESTIYN , VRETIREYN ) SELECT #{copyEstiCode} as "vEstiCode" /* 01_평가연도 */ , VEMPLNO as "vEmplNo" /* 02_사번 */ , VNAME as "vName" /* 03_성명 */ , VDEPTNAME as "vDeptName" /* 04_센터명 */ , VTEAMNAME as "vTeamName" /* 05_팀명 */ , VPOSNAME as "vPosName" /* 06_직위명 */ , VPASSWORD as "vPassword" /* 07_암호 */ , VGRADE as "vGrade" /* 08_등급 */ , VESTIYN as "vEstiYn" /* 09_평가대상 여부 */ , VRETIREYN as "vRetireYn" /* 10_퇴사여부 */ FROM TCA4002
AND VESTICODE = #{searchEstiCode}
